candidates.description: This vector activates on various numerical values, particularly rounded or three-digit numbers.
This feature activates on medical, anatomical, and biological terms, particularly relating to neurology, the nervous system, and bodily structures.
The tokens relate to biological, chemical, and physical processes involving environmental interaction and energy exchange.
This vector represents common Spanish adjectives and adverbs expressing qualities, quantities, or relations.
This feature activates on words containing Latin-derived root morphemes related to continuation, diversity, and observation (such as *univers*, *divers*, *contin*, and *observ*).
This feature activates on sub-word tokens containing variations of the Latin root 'contin' related to continuation or continuity.
This vector represents biological taxonomy and life sciences terminology across multiple languages.
This vector represents Spanish verbs, particularly common auxiliary and action verbs conjugated across various tenses and moods.
This vector represents proper nouns, foreign words, and word fragments, particularly names and capitalized terms spanning multiple languages.
This vector activates on action verbs and instrumental terms used to describe functional utility, application, or process mechanisms across multiple languages.
